explanation:
√cur (steal) + *e > core
core + ti > coreti (he steals)
√cur (steal) + *aya > coraya
coraya + ti > corayati (he steals)

√kar 7 o (do, make) > kar + o > karo
karo + ti > karoti (he does, makes)

√gah (grasp) + ṇhā > gaṇhā
gaṇhā + ti > gaṇhāti (he grabs, takes)

√ci (collect) + nā > cinā
cinā + ti > cināti (he collects)

√su (hear) + ṇā > suṇā
suṇā + ti > suṇāti (he hears)

√div (shine) + ya > dibba
dibba + ti > dibbati (he shines, illuminates)

√bhuj (eat) + ṃa > bhuṃja > bhuñja
bhunja + ti > bhuñjati (he eats, enjoys)

√kam (go) + a > kama
kama + ti > kamati (he goes)
